entries.source: RIplus Regg. Pfalzgrafen 1 n. 4741: Karlsr. Copb. 465,101 (in die innoc.).
entries.german: Ruprecht belehnt Else von Erlekeim, wittwe Eberhards von Rosenberg, an ihrer unmündigen söhne statt, mit Boxberg halb und andern lehengütern.
entries.english: Rupert enfeoffed Else von Erlekeim, widow of Eberhard von Rosenberg, in place of her underage son, with half of Boxberg and other fiefdoms.
facts: Elisabeth von Erligheim is widow of Eberhard von Rosenberg
Elisabeth von Erligheim received half of Boxberg and other feudal goods on behalf of her minor sons
Eberhard von Rosenberg had minor sons with Elisabeth von Erligheim
Ruprecht granted fiefs to Elisabeth von Erligheim as guardian of her minor sons
Eberhard von Rosenberg was deceased by 1387
